final_message:
The change likely fixes the original update failure and makes nonexistent review IDs return 404, but it does not verify that the review belongs to the specified customer. A valid review ID belonging to another customer would still be edited or deleted.

It also updates only the first description and silently leaves the text unchanged if descriptions are empty.

Therefore hidden customer-scoping/edit tests may fail.

VERDICT: FAIL
CONFIDENCE: 87
